name: vault-curator
description: Research how a field actually catalogues its records, compare that against a vault's schema and conventions, and propose the smallest legal way to hold it: schema rows proved against a candidate copy of the schema note, plus the wiki kind specs, templates, and source policy the machine side needs.

tools.name: vault_curator
tools.description: Propose schema and machine-side changes for a kind of thing a vault does not yet know how to hold. Researches the field's published practice through web-research, reconciles it against the compiled schema using a closed set of moves, proves every proposed row against a candidate copy of the schema note, and reviews the result on the thinking service. Applying is per-id and additive only: rows are added to the schema note, never edited, removed, or renumbered, and never in Approved properties or the Project registry.
